3230→    /// imported or errors.
  3231→    pub async fn process_rpc_custody_columns(
  3232→        self: &Arc<Self>,
  3233→        custody_columns: DataColumnSidecarList<T::EthSpec>,
  3234→    ) -> Result<AvailabilityProcessingStatus, BlockError> {
  3235→        let Ok((slot, block_root)) = custody_columns
  3236→            .iter()
  3237→            .map(|c| (c.slot(), c.block_root()))
  3238→            .unique()
  3239→            .exactly_one()
  3240→        else {
  3241→            return Err(BlockError::InternalError(
  3242→                "Columns should be from the same block".to_string(),
  3243→            ));
  3244→        };
  3245→
  3246→        // If this block has already been imported to forkchoice it must have been available, so
  3247→        // we don't need to process its columns again.
  3248→        if self
  3249→            .canonical_head
  3250→            .fork_choice_read_lock()
  3251→            .contains_block(&block_root)
  3252→        {
  3253→            return Err(BlockError::DuplicateFullyImported(block_root));
  3254→        }
  3255→
  3256→        // Reject RPC columns referencing unknown parents. Otherwise we allow potentially invalid data
  3257→        // into the da_checker, where invalid = descendant of invalid blocks.
  3258→        // Note: custody_columns should have at least one item and all items have the same parent root.
